name: The anxious professional
story: Wired by day, ruminating at night. Wants calm without losing the next morning.
caution: Anxiety is the group most sensitive to paranoia tags. Read the risk reasons before the fit score.

name: Trauma and broken sleep
story: Hypervigilant, light sleeper, startles easily. Looking for settling rather than stimulation.
caution: Panic can be triggered by strong activation. Anything labelled High risk is a reason to skip, not to dose lower.

name: Winter low mood
story: Energy and motivation drop every autumn. Wants lift without a crash or a racing evening.
caution: Persistent low mood deserves clinical support. Light, sleep and movement usually outrank any strain.

name: Mood-swing caution
story: Bipolar II or cyclothymic pattern. Highs and lows are the main concern, so stimulation is the main risk.
caution: Cannabis can precipitate hypomania or mania and worsen mood cycling. Talk to your prescriber first. Treat this lens as a way to see what to avoid.

name: Cycle-linked mood
story: Irritability, tension and anxiety in the premenstrual window.
caution: Track timing. If the pattern is severe, PMDD has effective medical treatments.

name: Cutting back, compulsion-prone
story: Already notices a pull toward repeat use, like gaming or scrolling. Wants to see what a conservative lens looks like.
caution: If you are trying to quit, the reset section on the home page comes first. Not using is a valid result.

name: No condition, just curious
story: No diagnosis in play. Wants the plain low-volatility view.
caution: With nothing selected the finder uses the baseline lens.
